calibration: provisional; measures demonstrated evidence readiness, not human origin or population quality

checks.input_origin: Original origin supported by evidence beyond style or author metadata
checks.output_disclosure: Derivative origin and exact source lineage disclosed

checks.creator_attribution: Creator assertions, verified identities and unknowns explicitly distinguished
checks.chronology: Business, save, export and analysis times distinguished; no future-input leakage

checks.grounded_need: Concrete consequential task and role supported by source content
checks.verified_result: Substantive outcome independently checked against sources

checks.required_content: Required task-specific fields and calculations available
checks.dependencies: Missing evidence, exceptions and remaining business actions explicit

checks.usable_inputs: Required input bytes inspected and available
checks.distinct_output: A substantive usable output separate from inputs exists

checks.supported_edges: Each workflow link has a cited business or derivation basis
checks.connected_path: Every required input reaches a demonstrated output through an acyclic graph

checks.stage_coverage: All frozen required analytical stages have evidence
checks.independent_acceptance: Separate reviewer confirms final output; real business completion is separately stated

checks.native_checks: Native contents, calculations and extraction fidelity checked as applicable
checks.presentation: Relevant rendered pages, sheets or images actually reviewed
